segments.name: Residential Segment
segments.description: Owns, develops and operates multifamily apartment properties in the Southern United States, renting apartments and tenant services such as parking and storage to residents.
segments.evidence: The services for our multifamily segment include primarily rental of apartments and other tenant services, including parking and storage space rental.

segments.name: Commercial Segment
segments.description: Owns and manages office buildings and commercial properties, leasing office space and providing tenant services such as parking and storage to business tenants.
segments.evidence: The services for our commercial segment include primarily rental of office space and other tenant services, including parking and storage space rental.

revenueModel.text: Residents and commercial tenants pay rent and fees for apartments or office space, parking and storage.
revenueModel.evidence: The services for our segments include rental of property and other tenant services, including parking and storage space rental.
